_nota: U-113/U-137/U-141 bubble verification, all 17 sheets swept by eye (36 dpi overviews + 85-120 dpi zooms of every plan/detail area) and by a vector circle scan. Detector inventario.ocurrencias.detail_bubble = 60: 27 real callouts (A2.0 11, A3.0 1, A4.0 10, A5.0 5, counting each arrow of an elevation marker; + 1 written ref added by eye on A2.0) PLUS 31 are VIEW TITLE markers of the destination views themselves (kept as no_es_burbuja + used for _destinos) and 2 are misreads of written notes (A0.1 DB0001 'ON/A0.2', A4.0 DB0039 'NO/A0.2'). detail_ref_text (6) and set_texto 'vector N/HOJA en una linea' items are WRITTEN references in keynotes (kept with ref_texto, destinations followed). set_texto burbujas 'marca de elevacion' ids are WRONG on A2.0, A4.0 (true: 8 top/7 right/6 bottom/9 left) and A5.0 (true: 2 top/3 right/4 bottom/5 left); all 11 indep_no_detectados rings are north arrows (7) or exit-sign symbols (3 on A3.0) -> img_verif/indep_anillos.png. Added by eye: 1/M0.0 bubble on M1.0 (grille & diffuser schedule header) and the written ref 8/A2.0 in A2.0 key note 6. Sheets with NO detail callouts: A0.1 (only title + legend), A0.2, A0.3, A1.0 (keynotes only), E0.0, E1.0, E2.0, E2.1, E3.0, M0.0, M2.0, P1.0 (E/M/P: hexagon key notes, circled view titles; text refs to 2/E1.0, 2/E2.0, 3/E2.0, 5/P1.0 only). Details with NO inbound callout: 2/A2.0 WALL TYPES (reached via W-tags), 7/A2.0 TYPICAL HEAD DETAIL (JAMB SIM) (applies typ. at door heads; F.R.T. wood blocking in it = Div 06), 2/A3.0 ALLOWABLE CEILING SPANS L/240 (stud/joist table), 2/A4.0 ACCESSIBLE POS, BLOCKING LEGEND - SALES WALL FIXTURES (A5.0, unnumbered, reached by text). Rendering note: in this PyMuPDF (1.28/2.1) get_pixmap(clip=...) takes the VISIBLE rect directly; clip=rect*derotation_matrix renders the wrong area. All crops were made and re-opened with visible clips.
_frame: visible frame pt (page.rect after rotation 270, 3024 x 2160, origin top-left = rendered PNG). set_texto indep_no_detectados were unrotated and are converted (x_vis=y_u, y_vis=2160-x_u). Text-ref x,y on E/P sheets are approximate positions inside the SHX note block.
